basis: One unbroken 9 s continuation of the sh024 set-up: Alice still seated in mid-air on the shaft_centre anchor, still drifting at about 0.09 m/s (y 2.06 -> 1.25), eyes closing at t=1.2, head tipping to one side at t=2.4 and nothing else moving. The rig holds its sh024 offset and falls with her; the last empty pegs clear the top of frame around t=6.5 and the two heavy thumps at t=8.4 land over black, so the shot ends with no new staging.
warnings: sh025 is the sh024 set-up continued unbroken, so both actors and camera inherit from grp009 rather than cutting.
Rig descends with Alice; no pan, tilt, reframe or lens change for the full 9 s.

issues.question: Same root cause as WBI-ep01-grp001-001: she drops out of the modelled 6 m rig section during this group (y 1.25 at the group end) and the 'last empty pegs' she passes are modelled once, at y 4.15-4.65, far above her. Ship the single-section drift, or re-model the shaft as a repeating/taller volume first?
issues.provisional: Keep the monotonic drift through the single modelled section and let the plate carry the travelling dressing; the reference then gives correct fall rate, pose and rig behaviour but not the dressing that passes her.

options.label: Re-model SCN-falling-dream as a repeating/taller shaft with the dressing the descent names
